title: Build a Stampede-Proof Cache Loader
summary:
A hot key expires and 10,000 requests hit the database at once — the **cache stampede** (thundering herd) behind many real outages. You build the read-through loader that prevents it: **single-flight** per key (one loader call, everyone shares the result), **stale-while-revalidate** with soft and hard TTLs, **negative caching** for keys that don't exist (penetration protection), **errors that never poison the cache**, a global **concurrency limit** on loader calls, and correct **invalidation during an in-flight load**. Tests drive every race by hand with deferred promises and an injected clock.

Interview payoff: you can name the three cache failure modes (stampede, penetration, avalanche) and the fixes for each, explain why stale-while-revalidate trades freshness for tail latency, why a failed load must not be cached or shared with future callers, and why `invalidate` must fence off a read that started before the write.

milestones.name: M1: Single-flight
milestones.description: Concurrent `get`s for one key share one loader call; keys are independent; fresh values are served with no load.

milestones.name: M2: Errors don't poison
milestones.description: All joined waiters see the same rejection; nothing is cached; the flight is cleared so the next `get` retries. Synchronous throws behave like rejections.

milestones.name: M3: Stale-while-revalidate
milestones.description: Within `[freshMs, freshMs + staleMs)` return the stale value immediately and run exactly one background refresh; failed refreshes call `onError` and keep the stale value; past the hard TTL callers wait.

milestones.name: M4: Negative caching
milestones.description: `undefined` results are cached for `negativeTtlMs` (not `freshMs`); without it, misses are not cached but are still single-flighted.

milestones.name: M5: Concurrency limit
milestones.description: A FIFO semaphore caps running loader calls across all keys; failed loads free their slot; a 1,000-request stampede over 10 keys makes exactly 10 calls.

milestones.name: M6: Invalidation races
milestones.description: `invalidate` during a load: old waiters get their result, but it is not stored, and the next `get` starts a new load (generation counter).
